segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Morning, everyone. Let’s do the launch stand-up. We have about seven minutes, I think.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Cool. Quick check: we’re still aiming for the October nineteenth app launch?

segments.speaker: Arjun
segments.text: As of this morning, yes. The build is mostly there. Mostly.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Let’s take Android first. What did you find?

segments.speaker: Arjun
segments.text: On Android fourteen, onboarding can crash after you deny notifications, then go back.

segments.speaker: Arjun
segments.text: Yeah. Allow is fine, and Android thirteen is fine. I reproduced it twice.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Okay, that’s launch-blocking for me. Can you own the fix?

segments.speaker: Arjun
segments.text: Yep. I’ll fix the Android 14 onboarding crash and get a build to QA by tomorrow afternoon.

segments.speaker: Arjun
segments.text: Will do. Actually, QA can do the first pass; Meera can check the visual state after.

segments.speaker: Meera
segments.text: Right, I meant the visual state. Not the whole device matrix.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Noted. Meera, please check the visual state once the fix lands.

segments.speaker: Meera
segments.text: Yep. The screen itself is done; I’m tightening the empty state now.

segments.speaker: Meera
segments.text: Exactly. The illustration was too loud, and the button looked like a second headline.

segments.speaker: Meera
segments.text: Smaller illustration, clearer “Add a place” button, and a hint that they can skip it.

segments.speaker: Meera
segments.text: Good. I wasn’t asking you to build it again.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: When can you hand off the updated empty state?

segments.speaker: Meera
segments.text: Today by four. I’ll export the empty state variants and drop them in the launch folder.

segments.speaker: Meera
segments.text: Sure, once I export them. Please don’t use the old blue one; it’s retired.

segments.speaker: Sam
segments.text: Got it. I’ll wait for the new files.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Sam, where are we on launch messaging?

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: What’s the value prop right now?

segments.speaker: Sam
segments.text: Find a good place nearby, save it, and get back to your day. Less “discover your next adventure.”

segments.speaker: Sam
segments.text: Exactly. I’ll draft launch email subject options and send three to the group by noon tomorrow.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Great. Do we need the partner quote in this first email?

segments.speaker: Sam
segments.text: We don’t have approval yet. I can ask, but I wouldn’t hold the email for it.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Agreed. No quote in the launch email unless approval comes in by Friday.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: I thought we said maybe. What’s left?

segments.speaker: Sam
segments.text: Then I can’t promise invite rewards in the campaign anyway.

segments.speaker: Meera
segments.text: Can we just leave the share button hidden for launch?

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Yes. Decision: referrals stay out of the October launch; we’ll revisit after attribution is solid.

segments.speaker: Arjun
segments.text: Works for me. I’ll keep the unfinished entry point behind the flag.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Please don’t spend time polishing the referral screen this week, then.

segments.speaker: Sam
segments.text: On the store listing, do we have final screenshots?

segments.speaker: Meera
segments.text: Not final. The first two are ready, but the settings screen still has placeholder copy.

segments.speaker: Meera
segments.text: Probably. I need to check whether those need localized screenshots for the beta markets.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: We’re only opening the beta in English-speaking markets, right?

segments.speaker: Sam
segments.text: US and Canada for the invite wave. We haven’t committed to the UK yet.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Then let’s keep the beta English-only, US and Canada. That’s the decision for this launch wave.

segments.speaker: Meera
segments.text: Okay, I can prep the screenshots for those two. I don’t know if the store needs separate Canadian spelling, though.

segments.speaker: Sam
segments.text: I’ll check the listing requirements and tell you. I won’t edit the artwork.

segments.speaker: Meera
segments.text: Perfect. I’ll export the two ready screens today, but hold the settings one until copy is final.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Oh. We changed that last week, didn’t we?

segments.speaker: Arjun
segments.text: The app sends place_saved. The dashboard filter still says place_bookmarked.

segments.speaker: Arjun
segments.text: It means saved-place counts are low in the report. Raw events are there.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Let’s standardize on place_saved. I’ll confirm that with analytics and update the event glossary today.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Yes, that’s yours after my confirmation. I’ll ping you by three.

segments.speaker: Sam
segments.text: I can pull the email number from the raw events for the draft, then.

segments.speaker: Sam
segments.text: Sure. The email isn’t going out until launch week, anyway.

segments.speaker: Meera
segments.text: One design question: are we still putting the notification prompt on first open?

segments.speaker: Arjun
segments.text: It currently appears after someone saves their first place.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Let’s keep the prompt after the first save. No change needed for this build.

segments.speaker: Sam
segments.text: I need a final launch date for the email calendar. Still October nineteenth?

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Yes, target stays October nineteenth, pending the Android fix and store review. That’s a target, not a promise.

segments.speaker: Sam
segments.text: I’ll label it tentative in the calendar. No public date yet.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Good. Anything else actually blocked?

segments.speaker: Meera
segments.text: Just final settings copy. I sent the wording yesterday, but no one has approved it.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: I haven’t seen it. Can you resend the link after this?

segments.speaker: Meera
segments.text: Yep, I’ll resend it in the launch channel. That’s just the link, not a new copy pass.

segments.speaker: Sam
segments.text: I can review the wording for tone once it’s in there, if useful.

segments.speaker: Meera
segments.text: That’d help, but I still need Priya to approve the actual product text.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: I’ll review the settings copy by end of day. Sam, you can leave comments, but don’t rewrite it.

segments.speaker: Sam
segments.text: Understood.

segments.speaker: Arjun
segments.text: Anything needed from engineering for the store screenshots?

segments.speaker: Meera
segments.text: No, the screens are captured already. I only need the final copy before I export the last one.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Okay. Quick recap: Android fix and QA build tomorrow, design exports today, email subjects tomorrow, and I confirm the event name by three.

segments.speaker: Arjun
segments.text: And I update the dashboard filter after that confirmation.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Right. Referrals stay out, beta is US and Canada in English, and the prompt stays after first save.

segments.speaker: Sam
segments.text: I’ll mark the date tentative and send the subject options tomorrow at noon.

segments.speaker: Meera
segments.text: I’ll drop the new empty states in the folder by four. Great.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Thanks, everyone. That’s it. Bye.
